summary: Solid, well-documented preregistered paired study showing negligible aggregate benefit from a single-step deterministic validator+one-repair (GVR) gate because the baseline generator was near-ceiling on the chosen task set. Artifacts and hashes are extensive and largely consistent. A few manuscript clarifications are required to remove ambiguities in provenance/accounting and to make validator semantics discoverable to readers who will inspect the archived artifacts.
critical_issues: Manuscript omits an explicit, human-readable summary of the deterministic validator’s operational rules (what exactly counts as an "unintended reachability change") and the validator implementation pointer. The transformation manifest exists (execution/transformation_manifest.json SHA-256 = b6ba6a75fa59f12f6b67e16aa5702f0fb95ba94cdb8d9b7e4d9b530c1ea76eb1) but the paper should cite and summarize the validator’s key checks and assumptions.

The provider_call_audit field shown in the execution manifest includes a potentially confusing entry "condition_counts": {"shared": 300, "guarded": 1} which is inconsistent with the stated completed_episode_count = 600 and completed_episode breakdown; this can confuse readers about how many guarded calls occurred. The manuscript must explain the provider-call accounting fields (shared_initial vs per-condition call counts) and confirm that the full provider-call trace archive matches the textual description.

The preregistered secondary hypothesis H2 is reported as untestable because there were no residual guarded failures; the paper should state this more prominently in the abstract and conclusions and remove any wording that could be read as having empirically evaluated H2.
required_revisions: Add a concise, explicit description in the manuscript of the deterministic validator’s semantics (what constitutes an unintended reachability change, principal check steps, and major assumptions). Cite execution/transformation_manifest.json (SHA-256 = b6ba6a75fa59f12f6b67e16aa5702f0fb95ba94cdb8d9b7e4d9b530c1ea76eb1) and the per-episode validator traces path (execution/scoring/ and execution/responses/) and include the validator id/version string (deterministic_netops_validator_v5) and its version (5.0). This is a textual clarification resolvable from supplied artifacts.

Clarify provider-call accounting in the Methods/Execution section: explain meaning of "shared_initial_generation", "repair" counts, and the provider_call_audit/condition_counts fields (why condition_counts shows {"shared":300,"guarded":1}) and confirm that model_calls_used = 301 equals 300 shared initial calls plus the single repair call (execution/provider_calls/task-000117-guarded-repair.json SHA-256 = 4deb410d5736ab332cd5caaf00b16051e5b0aef2276255c0770098f63cb523ba). This is a manuscript clarification that can be resolved from execution_manifest.json and the call-trace artifacts.

Add an explicit, prominent statement in the Abstract and Conclusion that H2 was preregistered but unassessable with the observed data (zero residual guarded failures), and remove or reword any phrasing that could be read as having empirically tested H2. Point readers to the per-episode failure-mode artifacts (e.g., analysis/paired_contingency_table.csv SHA-256 = 3421adb52d5791a979397368165fc2062e6b9a4a771ce49c0bcac80b02215d55 and execution/responses/task-000117-*.txt) to support this clarification. This is resolvable from archived analysis files.
optional_revisions: Consider adding an explicit citation (path+SHA) to the deterministic_reconciliation.json (analysis/deterministic_reconciliation.json; SHA-256 = f6da505032ab388ceccda8e85084b53b8cada91a7ccc0dc65601385505f00ea6) in the Results or Reproducibility pointer section so reviewers/readers can directly confirm pair accounting and provider-call audits.

Add a short paragraph (or appendix paragraph) discussing why exact McNemar returned p=1.0 and the implications of performing alternative small-sample tests or reporting exact one-sided discordant-pair confidence intervals; include the simple numeric discordant table (n11=299,n10=1,n01=0,n00=0) inline for clarity. This is optional and can be prepared from analysis/paired_contingency_table.csv.

Optionally expand the Discussion to recommend concrete selection criteria for future task distributions (e.g., target baseline accuracy ranges or adversarial/noisy intents) that would meaningfully evaluate GVR benefits; link to the archived tasks (execution/task_manifest.jsonl SHA-256 = 91564bb69ac692e2fbd6321708863d13938309b5433ef1b211541ba5426df990).
